summary: Focused verification of the user-reported theme bug: PRODUCTS mega menu + search overlay theming in light/dark, plus navigation regressions. All targeted checks PASSED. Light theme mega menu panel now renders rgba(244,244,242,0.98) with dark text (category headers rgb(10,10,10), subcategory links rgb(82,82,91), featured app titles rgb(10,10,10), quick-link pills rgb(82,82,91), mega search input text rgb(10,10,10)). Dark theme unchanged: panel rgba(5,5,5,0.98) with white/zinc text. Search overlay verified in both themes (light: panel rgba(244,244,242,0.98), input rgb(10,10,10), popular machine cards white bg rgb(255,255,255) with dark titles; dark: panel rgba(5,5,5,0.98), text rgb(250,250,250)). Live search for 'archer' returned 1 readable result in both overlays and both themes. Functional regressions all green: mega category -> /laptops, mega search result -> /laptops/archer-ltg540z, popular model card -> /laptops/archer-ltg540z, overlays/menu auto-close on selection, chat FAB (chat-toggle) visible and opens chat-panel with FAQ chips and Turnstile after closing overlays. Theme persistence via localStorage 'latios-theme' behaved consistently (html class toggles 'light').

issues: Top utility bar keeps its dark navy #0b1226 background via keep-dark while the rest of the page is white — intentional per code, but visually it is the only dark strip in light mode; confirm it is the desired look vs jwipc-style all-white.
Chat panel remains dark-themed while the site is in light mode (not in scope of this fix, flagging for consistency review).

critical_code_review_comments: Overlay theming is now driven by a single .overlay-panel rule in index.css (dark rgba(5,5,5,0.98) / html.light rgba(244,244,242,0.98)) — good, avoids per-component duplication.
Optional: consider whether topbar keep-dark and the chat panel should also become theme-aware for a fully white light theme.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme bug fix verified in iteration 7 — do not retest overlay theming. Playwright notes: header not sticky, evaluate window.scrollTo(0,0) + 500ms wait before header clicks; toggle theme via [data-testid=theme-toggle] and assert document.documentElement.className contains 'light'; networkidle never settles (Lenis) — use wait_for_selector. Popular machine cards only render when search input is empty.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: mega menu and search overlay carried a keep-dark pin that excluded them from html.light overrides, so panels stayed near-black in light theme. Fix (removing keep-dark and adding theme-aware .overlay-panel) verified via computed styles: panel background and all inner text now invert correctly.
